notes: Mission and values language (for example, 'make it universally available' and the company principles) was not scored above 1. Cross-cultural was weighed between 4 and 5: language learning removes language barriers, and the filing notes refugees among learners and more Irish and Hawaiian learners than native speakers. However, the core business is framed as education, so the lower level of 4 was chosen. The People and Culture section has only an inclusion statement, a legal-compliance hiring policy, and workforce background (E7, demographics only), with no employee networks or programs. No employee training programs are described. Free access and the freemium model are part of the same app (E1) and are not counted separately. The music course has no separate user figures. Math and Chess courses are covered under E1. The Item 7 excerpt on Duolingo English Test acceptance is truncated mid-sentence, so Item 1 was used for quotes. No small-business or founder-enabling activity is disclosed.
